collection.description: A villager enjoys clothing colors that others rarely choose for their gender.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager) enjoys clothing colors that others rarely choose for their gender.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The dye fades quickly, and (villager) tries a different shade.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (weaver) suggests a gentler dye after a first attempt stains unevenly.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (villager) decides the familiar color still feels right.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (villager) saves materials until a better dye is available.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The friends enjoy choosing unexpected colors together.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (villager) prefers a personal experiment rather than a group activity.
